name: AICostBudget AI API Pricing Dataset
statistics_scope: public pricing records returned by the public pricing adapter with Pricing V2 enabled
null_value_meaning: Not listed, not published, not applicable, or not currently available in the dataset; null is not zero.

features.pricing_components: Full conditional pricing components; [] when none apply.
features.pricing_components_json: Compact CSV JSON serialization of pricing_components.
features.time_pricing: Structured request-time pricing schedule; null when no temporal pricing applies.
features.time_pricing_json: Compact CSV JSON serialization of time_pricing.
features.unit_price: Primary non-token unit price; null for token-priced rows.
features.conditional_usage_allowances: Eligibility-scoped recurring allowances that remain separate from standard paid tiers.
features.conditional_usage_allowances_json: Compact CSV JSON serialization of conditional_usage_allowances.
features.model_selection: Independent model-default and explicit-ID support metadata; null when not published.
features.model_selection_json: Compact CSV JSON serialization of model_selection.
features.access_status: Independent official API access: public/existing_users_only/invite_only/restricted/unknown; not production selector enforcement.
features.access_checked_at: UTC timestamp of successful access verification, independent of pricing freshness.
features.access_evidence: Official access claim scope, exact official model ID, source reference and URL.
features.access_evidence_json: Compact CSV JSON serialization; appended additive column.
features.binding_evidence_json: Compact CSV JSON serialization; appended additive column.
